nuggets.text: The Bulldogs' 80 points against Northwestern State set a school record, topping 76 against Rice in 2014.
Jalen Mickens caught a 75-yard touchdown on the Bulldogs' very first play from scrimmage this season.
Sonny Cumbie threw for 520 yards and won Holiday Bowl MVP as Texas Tech's quarterback.
Sonny Cumbie was the third straight Texas Tech quarterback to lead the nation in passing.
Sonny Cumbie was an arena football Rookie of the Year with the Los Angeles Avengers.
The Bulldogs' live mascot is an English bulldog named Tech, from a line that has served since 1930.
Terry Bradshaw left Louisiana Tech owning virtually all of its passing records before a Hall of Fame career with the Steelers.
The Bulldogs' very first football game, in 1901, was a 57-0 loss to LSU.
Every Bulldogs player touches the Spirit of '88 statue before running onto the field, for good luck.
The Bulldogs are playing their first Sun Belt season after 13 seasons in Conference USA.
